name: Facet
text: Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **persistent, non-modal light/dark toggle** in the top bar. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low light and align with our competitive analysis (Manus, Graphify) for a cohesive, modern look. The trade-off is slightly higher battery drain on OLED screens, but the readability and brand consistency benefits outweigh it.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Defaulting to dark mode ignores users who work in bright environments—glare-sensitive users still get burned by reflections on OLED screens. A better alternative: start with a **light theme by default**, but let users pick a **high-contrast dark mode** for low-light work, and a **matte dark mode** to cut glare. Settle it with a live A/B test measuring task completion time and user-reported comfort across lighting conditions.
